subject: Use of non system default browser

messages.author: 954fe4a04c9cf730
messages.subject: Use of non system default browser
parts:
I will be developing some shiny apps for users in our company. Our MIS policies force use of IE as the default browser. Firefox can also be installed but cannot be the default browser. Installation of Chrome is blocked on our network. How do I run a Shiny app using a browser other than the system default?

Thanks for any help you can give, and Happy Thanksgiving! at least for those in the US.

Best wishes,
John

messages.author: 129e07bdb789652f
messages.subject: Re: Use of non system default browser
parts:
I use options(browser="C:/PortableApps/GoogleChromePortable/GoogleChromePortable.exe") but there's one problem : the help pages are open in this browser after setting this option.
But this solution is nice for a user which only uses the app, not R.

By the way I have recently tried the portable version of the Maxthon browser and it is nice.

messages.subject: Re: Use of non system default browser
parts:
OK. That was easy! We can't use portable browsers (especially Chrome) on our network. However, setting options(browser="C:/Program Files/Mozilla Firefox/firefox.exe") worked.

Thanks to Stephane!
